name: Shenzhen Cheng Chung Design Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Cheng Chung Design Co., Ltd. provides decoration design, consulting, supporting services, and construction services in China and internationally. It offers its services to hotels, high-end residences and office buildings, luxury clubhouses, commercial complexes, and other decoration and design fields. It also provides soft furnishing solutions, such as art consulting, home and lifestyle branding, and high-end private residence customization. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Asiantime International Construction Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Cheng Chung Design Co., Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
